players.product: Enterprise PCIe and SATA SSDs, RDIMM and CXL DRAM modules for servers, with in-house memory packaging and test (Huizhou) and wafer-level advanced packaging (Dongguan)

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Results briefing (company and chairman Sun Chengsi): AI emerging edge storage products earned about RMB 17.51 hundred million in 2025, of which AI-glasses storage about RMB 9.6 hundred million; in Q1 2026 AI edge storage revenue was about RMB 11.75 hundred million, up 496.45% year on year and 53.19% quarter on quarter. Its first in-house eMMC controller (SP1800) is in mass production and batch delivery, and the company expects in-house controller shipments to exceed 25 million units in 2026 (hedged: actual sales per later disclosures). The chairman said industry prosperity continues and Q2 results are expected to keep improving; the company said product prices still have some room to rise given AI and token demand, with memory makers now locking capacity for 2027 and beyond, and that its moving-weighted-average inventory costing smooths cost changes.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 AI edge storage revenue about RMB 11.75 hundred million (+496.45% YoY); 2026 in-house controller shipments expected above 25 million units

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Sun Chengsi (results briefing): Biwin supplies ROM+RAM memory chips for Meta's AI smart glasses and is a main domestic supplier to them; its ePOP products are used in AI/AR glasses and smartwatches by Meta, Google, Xiaomi, Alibaba, Imoo, Rokid and RayNeo.

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Sun Chengsi (results briefing): inventory stood at RMB 120.69 hundred million at end-Q1 2026, up 53.39% from end-2025, and its cost is still well below current selling prices; board secretary and CFO Huang Yanfeng attributed the operating cash outflow to higher purchasing. The Dongguan wafer-level advanced packaging project is proceeding with sampling and validation at customers' pace and, if adoption goes smoothly, should contribute revenue from end-2026; cooperation with Hygon Xinzheng is proceeding normally.
